title: 3.5 Boss: Order-Statistic Heist
objective: Query kth smallest element and key rank in O(log n) time using subtreeSize metadata.

queries.explanation: Root 40 has left size 4. Since 3 <= 4, go Left to 20. Left size of 20 is 1. Since 3 > 1+1, go Right to 30 with k = 3 - 2 = 1. Left size of 30 is 1. Since 1 <= 1, go Left to 25.
